name: Coffee Plant
hook: Coffee plant dropping leaves? It's probably too cold.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Indoors, it needs bright light but no harsh direct sun, like the dappled shade it grows in outdoors.

steps.title: Evenly moist, never soggy
steps.tip: Keep the soil evenly moist in the growing season, but overwatering causes root rot. Water less in winter.

steps.title: Humid air, no drafts
steps.tip: Give it moderate to high humidity, and keep it away from drafty doors and vents.

steps.title: Warm days, mild nights
steps.tip: Aim for 21–27°C by day and 16–18°C at night. Leaves can drop below about 13°C.

steps.title: Feed every 2 weeks
steps.tip: In the growing season, give a balanced liquid fertilizer every 2 weeks. Repot every 2–3 years in spring.

steps.title: Check for scale and mites
steps.tip: Look under leaves and on stems for scale, mealybugs, thrips and spider mites.

outro: Warmth, humidity and steady moisture keep coffee leaves glossy.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Coffea arabica

faqs.question: Will my coffee plant ever make beans?
faqs.answer: Expect flowers about 3–4 years after planting: small, fragrant and white, followed by berries that ripen from green to deep red. The seeds inside are the coffee beans.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Coffea arabica
